text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
<chrname> crossed the finish line in 1st place in 
the Japanese Derby. Her performance 
whipped up a tempest of blazing passion in 
the hearts of the crowd.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"If <chrname> is in, I might just become a 
supporter of 'Project L'Arc'..." Voices 
like that could be heard everywhere.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Let's turn the heat <chrname> created into an even 
bigger flame. Mei Satake makes her 
resolution.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
First, we must make sure the next 
Representative Exchange Race is on an even 
grander scale than the last. We'll make it 
a clash worthy of representing Japan, he 
said.
